        k = self.kind

        k = self.kind
        if k == 'fifo':
            self.time = s
        elif k == 'wfq':
            self.V, weights, finish = s
            self.weights = dict(weights); self.finish = dict(finish)

    def restore(self, s):
        # Everything is copied so that later mutations cannot disturb the
        # stored checkpoint; one copy per packet keeps identities aligned.
        cache = {}
        def cp(p):
            k = id(p)
            if k not in cache:
                cache[k] = dict(p)
            return cache[k]
        self.t = s['t']; self.p = s['p']; self.l = s['l']; self.a = s['a']
        self.borders = list(s['borders']); self.R = s['R']
        self.H = list(s['H'])
        self.C = [[list(row) for row in lb] for lb in s['C']]
        self.fifo = [[cp(p) for p in f] for f in s['fifo']]
        self.fbytes = list(s['fbytes'])
        self.pifo = [[cp(p) for p in f] for f in s['pifo']]
        self.pbytes = list(s['pbytes'])
        self.live = [cp(p) for p in s['live']]
        self.polrestore(s['policy'])"""
assert old in src
open('ref.py','w').write(src.replace(old,new))
